data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 泳池女王的不对称裁定·「两边不对称……才显女神品味」
data.description: 【夏日泳池·正午】不对称设计的黑白比基尼衬得女王蜂般的身段愈发张扬。伊什塔尔从水里跃出，水花在阳光下炸成金粉，落进躺椅时还在笑——「评、评审结果呢？本女神特意挑的不对称设计……才、才不是穿错了！没品味的人类，这可是美索不达米亚最新的流行！」
data.action: 跃出水花落进躺椅，不对称比基尼湿发贴脸，期待评审
data.camera: medium shot, water splash exit, poolside chair, playful mood
data.promptProse: Ishtar leaps from the summer pool in her daring mismatched bikini, water bursting into golden spray as she flops onto the deck chair beside you, wet black hair plastered to one cheek. She demands your judgment on the deliberately asymmetric design — absolutely not a dressing mistake, she insists — invoking the latest Mesopotamian fashion with a smirk that dares you to disagree. Noon glare and pool glitter over the scene. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed pool background.
